GENERAL — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: General
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which option best shows correct understanding of Impact of ICT on society? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Impact of ICT on society as empty slogans with no facts.
   B. Use Impact of ICT on society to shame classmates.
   C. Apply Impact of ICT on society with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Copy a rumour about Impact of ICT on society without checking.

2. Which option best shows correct understanding of Spreadsheet? (1 mark)
   A. Apply Spreadsheet with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   B. Use Spreadsheet to shame classmates.
   C. Copy a rumour about Spreadsheet without checking.
   D. Treat Spreadsheet as empty slogans with no facts.

3. Which option best shows correct understanding of Digital Citizenship? (1 mark)
   A. Apply Digital Citizenship with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   B. Treat Digital Citizenship as empty slogans with no facts.
   C. Use Digital Citizenship to shame classmates.
   D. Copy a rumour about Digital Citizenship without checking.

4. Which option best shows correct understanding of Database Management System? (1 mark)
   A. Use Database Management System to shame classmates.
   B. Treat Database Management System as empty slogans with no facts.
   C. Apply Database Management System with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Copy a rumour about Database Management System without checking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
5. In three clear sentences, explain Spreadsheet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. In three clear sentences, explain Database Management System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. In three clear sentences, explain Impact of ICT on society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

8. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

9. In three clear sentences, explain Spreadsheet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

10. In three clear sentences, explain Database Management System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
